items.exampleEn: The magazine is popular with avid gardeners.
items.exampleZh: 這本雜誌很受熱衷園藝的人歡迎。

items.exampleEn: A cold drink is very refreshing on a hot day.
items.exampleZh: 大熱天喝一杯冷飲非常提神。
items.glossZh: 提神的；令人耳目一新的

items.exampleEn: News of the factory closing caused great dismay in the town.
items.exampleZh: 工廠要關閉的消息讓全鎮驚愕又沮喪。

items.exampleEn: It is hypocrisy to ask others to save water while you wash your car every day.
items.exampleZh: 要別人省水，自己卻每天洗車，這就是虛偽。

items.exampleEn: Babies instinctively hold on to anything put in their hands.
items.exampleZh: 嬰兒會本能地抓住放進他們手裡的任何東西。

items.exampleEn: The ruthless king punished anyone who disagreed with him.
items.exampleZh: 那位冷酷無情的國王懲罰任何反對他的人。

items.exampleEn: She gave a candid interview about her early failures.
items.exampleZh: 她在訪談中坦率地談起自己早年的失敗。

items.exampleEn: The team's dismal performance disappointed its fans.
items.exampleZh: 球隊糟糕的表現讓球迷很失望。

items.sentenceEn: To her dismay, the shop had already closed.
items.sentenceZh: 令她沮喪的是，那家店已經關門了。

items.audioEn: The weather this weekend looks dismal, with rain on both days.
items.audioZh: 這個週末的天氣看起來很糟，兩天都會下雨。

items.sentenceEn: I instinctively closed my eyes when the ball came toward me.
items.sentenceZh: 球朝我飛過來時，我本能地閉上了眼睛。

items.sentenceEn: It is refreshing to meet someone so honest.
items.sentenceZh: 遇到這麼誠實的人，真令人耳目一新。

items.stemEn: The new manager is ____; she fires anyone who misses a deadline.
items.stemZh: 新經理很無情，誰錯過截止期限就開除誰。

items.stemEn: He tells everyone to be on time, but he is always late; his ____ is obvious.
items.stemZh: 他要大家準時，自己卻老是遲到，他的虛偽顯而易見。

items.passageEn: Our neighborhood restaurant guide is written by Ms. Ho, an avid cook who has eaten at almost every place in town. She is also the proud possessor of a huge collection of old recipes. Her reviews are candid but fair. Last month, she described one famous restaurant's service as dismal: the waiters ignored her for twenty minutes. She also pointed out the hypocrisy of a cafe that claims to be "green" but serves everything in plastic. Some owners call her ruthless, yet readers find her honesty refreshing. When she tastes something wonderful, she instinctively closes her eyes and smiles.
items.passageZh: 我們這一帶的餐廳指南是何女士寫的，她熱愛下廚，幾乎吃遍了鎮上每一家店。她還珍藏了一大批老食譜。她的評論坦率但公正。上個月，她形容一家知名餐廳的服務很糟：服務生整整二十分鐘都不理她。她也指出一家咖啡館的虛偽：號稱「環保」，卻什麼都用塑膠裝。有些店家說她冷酷無情，但讀者覺得她的誠實令人耳目一新。吃到美味的東西時，她會本能地閉上眼睛微笑。

questions.questionZh: 何女士怎麼形容那家知名餐廳的服務？
options: 很糟，服務生二十分鐘都不理她
覺得她太過嚴厲不公平

items.promptZh: 坦白說，我不太喜歡這個計畫。
referenceEn: To be candid, I don't really like this plan.
To be candid, I am not a big fan of this plan.
rubricZh: candid 表示「坦白的」，例如 To be candid, …、I'll be candid with you: … 等，放句首或句中皆可
「不太喜歡」可寫，例如 don't really like、am not a big fan of 等

items.promptZh: 我爸爸熱衷釣魚，每個週末都去海邊。
referenceEn: My father is an avid fisherman who goes to the sea every weekend.
My dad is an avid fan of fishing and goes to the beach every weekend.
rubricZh: 「熱衷的」用 avid（例如 an avid fisherman、an avid fan of fishing 等）
「每個週末」可寫，例如 every weekend、on weekends 等
「海邊」可寫，例如 the sea、the beach、the coast 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：評分要點寫死「To be candid…放在句首」：I'll be candid with you, …、…, to be candid. 等同樣正確，宜改「例如 To be candid, …（也可放句尾或寫 I'll be candid…）」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為「candid 表示「坦白的」，例如 To be candid, …、I'll be candid with you: … 等，放句首或句中皆可」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：The ruthless winter 不太道地（ruthless 多形容人或行為；天氣常用 harsh／brutal winter），未示範本字最常見用法
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改為形容人："The ruthless king punished anyone who disagreed with him."（與 q13 無情經理情境不同）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 與 q13 共用干擾項 avid、candid；情境與單字卡同為「浪費＋車」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q14 題幹改為「要別人準時、自己老遲到」，干擾項改為 dismay、vitality（名詞，放得進 his ____ is obvious 但語意不通）與 ruthless

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（同課 mcq 不可拿另一題正解當干擾項）：q14 用了 q13 正解 ruthless
執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：refreshing 釋義第一義「令人耳目一新的」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「提神的；令人耳目一新的」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：dismal 釋義第一義「陰沉的」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「糟糕的；陰沉的」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：dismay 例句「The sudden price rise dismayed many customers.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「沮喪、驚愕」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「News of the factory closing caused great dismay in the town.」示範第一義；釋義為「沮喪、驚愕；使沮喪」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：「不太喜歡」可寫，例如 don't really like、am not a big fan of 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：avid 表示「熱衷的」，用法例如 an avid fan、an avid reader 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（avid）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u10-l05-q17；目標字沿用 avid
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「我爸爸熱衷釣魚，每個週末都去海邊。」、hintWords ["avid"]、referenceEn ["My father is an avid fisherman who goes to the sea every weekend.","My dad is an avid fan of fishing and goes to the beach every weekend."]、rubricZh ["「熱衷的」用 avid（例如 an avid fisherman、an avid fan of fishing 等）","「每個週末」可寫，例如 every weekend、on weekends 等","「海邊」可寫，例如 the sea、the beach、the coast 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 avid 造一個句子，說說你熱衷的嗜好。」、referenceEn ["I am an avid fan of hiking, and I climb a mountain every month.","As an avid reader, I always carry a book on the train."]）
